title: Verse–Chorus–Bridge

body.text: A typical pop song has the structure
Intro → Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro
. Arranging the sections right gives the song a 'journey': the Verse tells the story, the Chorus is the core message, and the Bridge shifts the mood before returning to the hook.

example:
[Intro]
[Verse] tell the story of a new morning
[Chorus] an uplifting hook
[Bridge] shift the mood
[Chorus]
[Outro]

title: Special tags to shape the sound

body.text: Add hints in parentheses to suggest the instrumentation, like (guitar solo), (soft piano), (build up). Suno sometimes responds, adding dimension to the song. Experiment and listen to the results.

question: In general, what does the Chorus do in a song?

options.text: It's the core message / the catchy hook
Shifting the mood before returning to the hook

question: Why is arranging the sections important?

options.text: It gives the song an emotional journey and a professional feel
It makes the audio file smaller
It removes the need for lyrics
